definition: Candidate worker duration; maximum local receiver per update. Cold includes initial verification.

Maximum local trainer duration: handshake, publication, waiting for inference completion, release. Excludes the outer framework memory-reclaim and offer/cleanup wrapper. No warm reference replay is installed in this clean arm.

PrimeRL root time/broadcast_weights: memory reclamation plus the full sender.broadcast call, including offer/cleanup bookkeeping, coordination, publication, waiting for inference completion and release. Broader than pause/update/resume or receiver E2E. No warm reference replay is installed in this clean arm.

Orchestrator update_rpc after READY observation: pause/update/resume through acknowledgement for warm updates. Cold also includes generation/restoration controls. No server READY-transition timestamp. No warm reference replay is installed in this clean arm.
Orchestrator discovery before READY observation. Overlaps trainer readiness/publication; not MX internal source discovery.
